verdict.rationale: Evidence shows only built-in loaders (GLTFLoader), addons (OrbitControls, TransformControls, SVG/CSS3D renderers), an editor, and examples gallery — this is a modest core/addons ecosystem, not a dedicated large asset store or marketplace like a game engine would offer. Community feedback even notes basic model loading (OBJ) was historically painful, undercutting the 'ready-made assets' expectation. Missing for 10: a curated asset marketplace, third-party plugin registry, or large curated asset packs comparable to Unity/Unreal asset stores, and independent confirmation of a thriving plugin ecosystem beyond npm packages.
